public_message: We can do 70 tonnes at Rs.16,500 per tonne, delivered as you propose.
private_reasoning: Seller's Rs.17,500/t is above our target of Rs.15,500/t but below our ceiling of Rs.19,000/t, so we have room to negotiate down while keeping the deal alive. Reducing volume to our needed 70t and lowering price to Rs.16,500/t gets us closer to our target and still looks attractive to the seller, preserving the critical 3‑party loop.
